```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>"

is_gh_actions <- identical(Sys.getenv("CI"), "true")
```

## Install R packages

```{r install, eval = FALSE}
pkgs_cran <- c("geojsonsf", "rgee", "reticulate")
pkgs_runiverse <- "kwb.python"
pkgs <- c(pkgs_cran, pkgs_runiverse)
install.packages(pkgs, repos = c("https://cloud.r-project.org",
                                 "https://kwb-r.r-universe.dev"))


### Downgrade to last one supplied by R package "rgee"
kwb.python::conda_py_install("ad4gd", pkgs = list(conda = c("python=3.12.2",
                                                            "numpy"),
                                                  py = "earthengine-api==0.1.370"))




```

## Use

```{r use, eval = !is_gh_actions}
reticulate::use_condaenv("ad4gd")

```

### Get Lakes Berlin

```{r lakes_berlin}
url <- "https://fbinter.stadt-berlin.de/fb/atom/Gewaesserkarte/Gewaesserkarte.zip"
tfile <- basename(url)

download.file(url, destfile = basename(url))

unzip(zipfile = tfile,
      exdir = "gewaesser_berlin")

gewaesser_flaechen <- sf::read_sf("gewaesser_berlin/Gewaesser_Berlin_Flaechen.shp",
                                  options = "ENCODING=WINDOWS-1252")

gewaesser_flaechen$area <- sf::st_area(gewaesser_flaechen)

#View(gewaesser_flaechen)

gewaesser_flaechen <- gewaesser_flaechen %>%
  dplyr::filter(stringr::str_starts(GEWART, pattern = "Stehendes"))

sum(gewaesser_flaechen$area)/1000000


```

### Get Satellite Data

```{r satellite_data, eval = ! is_gh_actions}
library(rgee)

rgee::ee_Initialize()


system.time(
lakes_0107_centroid <- kwb.satellite::gee_get_data_for_years(years = 2019,
                                                          lakes = gewaesser_flaechen[1:7, ],
                                                          #bands = NULL,
                                                          centroid = TRUE)
)

min_size_for_parallel = 10L

# Should we do parallel processing?
doParallel <- length(gewaesser_flaechen) >= min_size_for_parallel && 
  (ncores <- parallel::detectCores() - 1L) > 1L

sat_data <- if (doParallel) {
      (ncores <- parallel::detectCores() - 1L) 
      # Prepare parallel processing
      cl <- parallel::makeCluster(ncores)
      on.exit(parallel::stopCluster(cl))
      
      
      
       kwb.utils::catAndRun(
        sprintf(
          "Downloading satellite data for %d lakes in parallel on %d cores",
          nrow(gewaesser_flaechen),
          ncores
        ),
        expr = {
          # Call the call_with_data function in a (parallel) loop
          parallel::parLapply(cl, 
                              1:7, 
                              fun = function(idx) {
                                lakes <- gewaesser_flaechen[idx,]
                                print(lakes)
                                reticulate::use_condaenv("ad4gd")
                                rgee::ee_Initialize()
                                kwb.satellite::gee_get_data_for_years(
                                years = 2018, 
                                lakes = lakes,
                                #bands = NULL,
                                centroid = TRUE
                                )})
        }
      )

    } else {
      #do nothing
    }


id_df <- tibble::tibble(id = seq_along(lake_01), 
               id_name = names(lake_01))

lake_01_df <- dplyr::left_join(id_df, 
                               dplyr::bind_rows(lake_01, .id = "id") %>% 
                               dplyr::mutate(id = as.integer(id)), 
                               by = "id") %>% 
  tidyr::unnest(satellite_data)

tmp <- system.time(get_data(lakes = lakes[1:10, ], via = "getinfo"))


```
## Info 

### Session Info

```{r session-info}
sessioninfo::session_info() %>%
  details::details(open = TRUE)
```

### Python Info


```{r reticulate_01, echo = TRUE}
env_yml <- kwb.python::conda_export("ad4gd", export_dir = ".")

paste0(readLines(env_yml), collapse = "\n") %>% 
  details::details(open = TRUE)



```

You can download the python environment used for this tutorial here:
[`r env_yml`](https://kwb-r.github.io/kwb.satellite/`r basename(env_yml)`). 
You can re-import to R with: 

```{r reticulate_02, eval = FALSE}
path_to_env_yml <- env_yml
reticulate::conda_create(envname = "ad4gd", environment = path_to_env_yml)
```
